`ShapeIndex` serialization has been implemented and committed to a new branch [`shapeindex-serialization`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8) branched from `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Shape Serialization Support**:
   - Added [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/point_vector.go#L49-L63) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/point_vector.go#L65-L103) methods to [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/point_vector.go).
   - Added [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polyline.go#L61-L75) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polyline.go#L77-L115) methods to [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polyline.go).
   - Added [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polygon.go#L228-L245) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polygon.go#L247-L308) methods to [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polygon.go) supporting multiple loops and empty/full polygon chains.
   - Added [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_loop.go#L92-L106) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_loop.go#L108-L146) methods to [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_loop.go).
   - Defined `typeTagLoop` and `typeTagLaxLoop` in [`shape.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shape.go#L152-L153), allowing all 7 built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shape.go) types ([`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/polygon.go), [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/polyline.go), [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/point_vector.go), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polyline.go), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_polygon.go), [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/loop.go), [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/lax_loop.go)) to round-trip.

2. **[`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex.go) Encode & Decode**:
   - Added [`Encode(w io.Writer) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex.go#L1615-L1726):
     - Automatically updates any pending additions or removals via `maybeApplyUpdates()` before serialization.
     - Serializes header metadata, `nextID`, `maxEdgesPerCell`, the shapes map preserving original shape IDs, and the full spatial cell structure ([`cellMap`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex.go#L597) and ordered [`cells`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex.go#L599)).
     - Encodes empty indices to non-empty byte streams.
   - Added [`Decode(r io.Reader) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex.go#L1728-L1894):
     - Restores original shape IDs and cell references.
     - Restores the spatial cell index directly in `fresh` status, enabling queries (`CrossingEdgeQuery`, `ClosestEdgeQuery`, `ContainsPointQuery`) and cell iteration (`ShapeIndexIterator`) without requiring [`Build()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex.go#L794).

3. **Malformed & Malicious Input Protection**:
   - Protected against oversized allocation attacks by enforcing upper bounds on shape counts, cell counts, vertex counts, and payload sizes, and by bounding initial slice and map capacities (`min(n, 1024)`).
   - Validates CellIDs, cell sort orders, shape ID existence, edge ranges, and dimensions (`containsCenter` checked against 2D shapes).
   - Never panics on corrupted bytes, truncated streams, or out-of-range data, returning descriptive errors.

4. **Testing**:
   - Added comprehensive tests in [`s2/shapeindex_serialization_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8qcfn9p8/s2/shapeindex_serialization_test.go) covering round-trips for all built-in types, mixed shapes, zero-edge shapes, full/empty geometries, mixed chain counts, shape ID preservation, unbuilt index encoding, immediate query execution, bitflip fuzz testing, and error handling for all classes of malformed input.
